title: AI Isn't Intelligent: It's a Prediction Engine! #shorts
description: Artificial intelligence doesn't 'think.' It's a sophisticated prediction engine, guessing the next word based on vast data. This is why AI hallucinates and confident incorrect answers are a major risk. #AIExplained #MachineLearning #TechFacts #ArtificialIntelligence
